register.headline: An exact contact refinement of SQUISH's packing of 272 squares
register.source_checks: The author reports that exact separating-axis and rational polygon-intersection implementations accept all 272 squares, 1,088 wall conditions and 36,856 pairs, for the new witness, the prior certificate and a pre-stationarity projection, with duplicate and outside controls refused and the conversion to its corners Witness/v2 lossless; and that this repository's sqpack exact_verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at 074ac28, accept that witness. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with this contact refinement, as the source asks, of Nate Chaoweeraprasit's SQUISH n272 (T-151, issue 500), whose components the source names as SQUISH's s(240) and the former Kingbird s(182) catalogue construction, with Evan Daniel's exact contact solver. The issue states: 'Computation, checking and submission preparation were AI-assisted; the requested attribution is as stated above.' The pinned source makes no statement about AI assistance.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then record source-specific adoption of the n272 side, 5.26e-16 below the ceiling T-151 holds and below every other report at 272 but the author's own PR #574, whose 40-place print does not separate it from this side.
